title: A producer moves between the five views by dock and by keyboard

steps.caption: A new project opens on the arrangement, five tiles in the dock
Press 2 with no clip: the view says what is missing
Point at the second tile: its tip names the view and key
Open the clip: the sequence view fills the page
Turn on a step that was off
Press 3: the instrument fills the page, tracks down the left
Press 5: pull the track's fader down in the mixer
Back to the arrangement from the dock
Reload the mixer: it reopens there, fader where you left it
